question: That "Conine" medicine that Mont Blanc Noland made really exists, doesn't it? The other day I just opened up a dictionary and happened to see a definition for "quinine", which is made from the bark of a "quina tree". Is that the basis for the medicine in the story? -Chief of the Top Secret One Piece Intelligence Gathering Agency- Quinine: An alkaloid made from quina bark. Works to relieve fever and stomachaches. Especially effective against malaria.
answer: Yes. It does exist. However the "wood fever" that I described in the story does not exist, so have no fear. Covering topics about disease is always delicate, as there is always the chance that people will find it too upsetting or it has too deep a historical context. Therefore authors tend to fudge the details somewhat.
